title: Runtime Tool Proposal Event
description: Canonical evidence for tool call proposals detected during inference.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier for this payload shape.

task_id_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the task identity.

proposal_count.description: Number of tool call proposals detected.

proposal_names_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the concatenated tool names (content-light).

proposal_args_hashes.description: SHA256 hashes of each proposal's arguments (content-light).

routed_to_governance.description: Whether proposals were routed to governance.

rejected_count.description: Number of proposals rejected by governance.

admitted_count.description: Number of proposals admitted for execution.

governance_latency_ms.description: Latency of governance routing in milliseconds.

content_light.description: Content-light guarantee: no raw tool arguments or names.
